note: The electronic passport's fee as a security source told Shafaq News on 15 October 2026: 101,000 dinars, up from 91,000 after the official dollar rate rose on 7 October. Validity and processing time aren't read.

sources.title: Shafaq News, New exchange rate lifts Iraqi passport costs (15 October 2026)
sources.said: Iraq has raised the fee for an electronic passport to 101,000 dinars ($66.45), up from 91,000 dinars ($59.87), a security source told Shafaq News on Thursday. The increase reflects a recent rise in the official US dollar exchange rate against the Iraqi dinar, according to the source, who said payments must be made exclusively through electronic channels, with the proceeds deposited into official federal government accounts.
